d: HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking aim to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We provide a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

The Manager, Unsecured Lending owns the end-to-end strategy, development, delivery and profitability of HSBC’s unsecured personal loan portfolio. The role drives growth, pricing, customer propositions and go-to-market plans while ensuring regulatory compliance, effective risk management, operational efficiency and collaboration across business and support functions.
q: Extensive experience in personal loan product management , including product strategy and portfolio management.
At least five years of relevant product management experience, ideally supported by a graduate-level business, finance or economics qualification.
Strong analytical, commercial and financial skills , including pricing optimisation, profitability analysis, Attrition management and data-driven decision-making.
Detailed knowledge of the United Arab Emirates retail financial services market, particularly consumer lending regulations affecting personal loans.
Strong stakeholder management and project coordination skills , with the ability to work across complex, multi-functional teams.
Knowledge of risk, compliance and operational controls , including customer due diligence, anti-money laundering requirements, internal controls and HSBC Group standards.

A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory.
r: Develop and implement the Personal Loan strategy to deliver balance sheet, revenue and profitability targets in line with the Annual Operating Plan.
Own the product lifecycle , from market research and business case development through launch, monitoring and review.
Manage pricing, portfolio mix and campaigns to drive growth, customer adoption, attrition management and sustainable returns.
Coordinate cross-functional delivery with Marketing, Distribution, Information Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Operations.

Improve customer experience through simple processes, customer-focused propositions, digitization of product onboarding and servicing customer journeys and resolution of the root causes of complaints.
Maintain strong governance and controls , ensuring compliance with HSBC standards, United Arab Emirates regulations, Fair Value Exchange, Value for Money and Treat the Customer Fairly principles.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.

d: The Specialist, Sales is responsible for driving sales growth by identifying opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and executing strategies to meet sales targets. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, presenting product offerings, and ensuring client satisfaction while contributing to the achievement of sales goals.
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve company objectives, including target setting, prospecting, and lead generation.
Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions.
q: Maintain expert knowledge of company products and services, effectively promoting their benefits and features to potential clients.
Prepare and present sales proposals, product demos, and pricing information to clients, negotiating terms and closing sales.
Monitor market trends, customer feedback, and competitor activity to adjust sales tactics and strategies accordingly.
Track and report on sales performance, providing regular updates to management on targets, activities, and achievements.
Work closely with marketing, customer service, and product teams to ensure smooth sales processes and customer satisfaction.
Provide ongoing support to customers, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive experience throughout the sales process.
Stay updated on industry trends and sales techniques through continuous learning and development.
Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job
To have a vision and a plan for the career path and how to achieve it.
Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules.
Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time.
Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks.
Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues.
Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities.
Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible.
Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions.

Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services.

Alfanar is a Saudi company with an international presence, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a wide variety of low, medium, and high voltage electrical products, in addition to its portfolio of conventional and renewable energy solutions, oil and gas, water treatment, infrastructure, technical services, and digital solutions.

The hub of alfanar’s manufacturing operations is Medinet alfanar Alsinaiya, a 700,000 square-meter complex located in Riyadh. The complex houses an array of ultra-modern manufacturing facilities and laboratories equipped with state-of-the-art technologies and staffed with highly skilled professionals.

alfanar derives its success from its commitment to providing the highest quality standards to its customers, and the continuous development of its human capital, who alfanar considers its most valuable asset. With this in mind, alfanar promotes a proactive work environment where its employees are always valued, nurtured, and empowered to fuel their pride in being part of alfanar.
For more information about alfanar, please visit alfanar.com

d: Help Shape How The World Sees Base360.
Work directly with our founder to turn product launches, founder stories and ambitious ideas into videos that earn attention, make people understand, and move them to act.
Meet the founder: Watch this 60-second video
Base360.ai is building the AI operating system for short-term rental companies.
Our platform grew out of the technology behind The Flex. We’re bringing that technology to other property managers, helping them launch, operate and scale their businesses on AI autopilot.
We’re looking for a Video Content Editor who can make a complex product easy to understand and find compelling stories in the people building it.
You’ll turn raw footage, product recordings and early ideas into launch films, founder content, social videos and ads.

Your involvement starts before the first cut. You’ll help shape concepts, identify the strongest angle, suggest hooks and decide how each story should unfold. Then you’ll own the edit through to delivery.
Some days, you’ll turn a long founder interview into a sharp, memorable story. On others, you’ll make a product feature instantly understandable or test different openings for an ad.
Success means creating videos that hold attention, communicate clearly and get the right people interested in Base360.
Create product launches and brand films. Combine storytelling, product demonstrations and motion graphics to show what Base360 makes possible.
Turn founder footage into compelling stories. Find the strongest moments in interviews, conversations and behind-the-scenes recordings.
Produce content for social platforms. Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn videos with openings, pacing and formats suited to each channel.
Develop and test ad creative. Explore different hooks, messages and calls to action, then use performance insights to improve the next version.
Own post-production. Handle footage selection, editing, colour grading, sound design, music, captions and final exports.
Help define our visual identity. Build a consistent approach to typography, motion, sound and composition across our videos.
Use AI to expand what you can create. Generate supporting visuals, voiceovers and other assets where they strengthen the work or speed up production.
A portfolio that shows your judgement. We want to see clear storytelling, deliberate pacing, strong visual choices and attention to detail.
Strong editing and motion skills. You’re proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, with experience in After Effects or an equivalent motion design tool.
An instinct for the opening. You know how to create interest in the first few seconds and sustain it through the rest of the video.
The ability to simplify. You can find the central idea in a long recording or complex product demonstration and build a clear story around it.
An ear for sound. You understand how music, silence, dialogue and sound effects influence the way a video feels.
Comfort with AI creative tools. You can incorporate tools such as Runway, Kling, Sora or ElevenLabs into your workflow when useful.
Experience with SaaS product videos, founder content, documentary storytelling or paid social ads is a plus.
Work directly with the founder. Help shape the stories behind the product and the business.
Have meaningful creative ownership. Bring ideas, develop new formats and influence how Base360 looks and sounds.
See your work make an impact. Your videos will support product launches, marketing campaigns and conversations with potential customers.
Grow with the company. There’s an opportunity to take on broader creative leadership and help build a video team.
Remote work with an ambitious, entrepreneurial team.
We move quickly, communicate directly and take responsibility for what we deliver.
You’ll be expected to bring ideas, make creative decisions, meet deadlines and improve your work through feedback. Priorities can change, and experimentation is part of the job.
This role suits someone who enjoys taking initiative, cares about both the craft and the outcome, and wants to keep raising the quality of their work.
